install.title: Get the app
steps: Tap “Get it on the App Store” above, then “Get” in the App Store.
Open “AIS同窓会” from your home screen.
Sign in the same way as on the web (an email code or LINE), or with “Sign in with Apple”.
Turn notifications on to get chats and news right away (you can change it later in Settings → App notifications).
install.openAppStore: Get it on the App Store
install.storeIntro: The AIS Alumni iPhone app is now on the App Store. Use your existing account: sign in the same way as on the web.
install.lineNote: The App Store may not open from in-app browsers such as LINE's. If so, choose “Open in Safari” from the menu at the bottom right (or top right), then try again.
notes: If you used the beta (TestFlight), install the app from the App Store too. From then on it updates from the App Store automatically.
The website keeps working as before.
On Android, open this page on your phone to see how to add the web app to your home screen.

admin.title: Sanctions
admin.description: Limit what a member can do. The member is notified and sees the reason. Applying and lifting are recorded in the audit log.

levelHints.WARNING: No limits. The member sees a notice until they acknowledge it.
levelHints.RESTRICTED: Read-only: no messages, reactions, comments, posts, follow requests or invitations.
levelHints.SUSPENDED: No access to the app for the period (only support, data download and account deletion).
levelHints.BANNED: No access, for good. The same email, LINE and Apple ID can't register again.

admin.endsAtPast: The end must be in the future.
admin.applyConfirm: The member will be notified. Any sanction in force is lifted.
admin.banConfirm: This account can no longer be used, and the same email, LINE and Apple ID can't register again. The member will be notified.
admin.liftConfirm: Lifts “{level}”. The member can use the app as usual right away.
admin.applyFailed: The sanction couldn't be applied. Check the form and try again.
